4363   /**
4364    * Implements {@link ConversionFinder} to provide all MarshallingContext-specific type conversions that cannot
4365    * be expressed in {@link BasicConverter} (which has no dependency on {@code juneau-marshall}).
4366    *
4367    * <p>
4368    * Conversions are resolved in this priority order:
4369    * <ol>
4370    *    <li>ObjectSwap-based conversions (highest priority)
4371    *    <li>Iso8601 date/time formatting and parsing
4372    *    <li>Epoch-millis to date/time
4373    *    <li>Map/Bean/Collection/Array to String via serializer
4374    *    <li>String/CharSequence to Array, Map, Collection via JSON parsing
4375    *    <li>Map to Bean and String to Bean via BeanMap
4376    *    <li>Calendar/Date specialized copies
4377    *    <li>InputStream and Reader construction
4378    * </ol>
4379    *
4380    * @param inType The input type class.
4381    * @param outType The output type class.
4382    * @return A matching {@link Conversion}, or {@code null} if none applies.
4383    */
4384   @Override
4385   @SuppressWarnings({
4386      "java:S6541", // Brain Method: conversion dispatch inherently requires handling many type pairs in one place
4387      "null" // `builder` is guarded by `nn(builder)` before access; Eclipse doesn't recognise `nn()` as a null-check function.
4388   })
4389   public Conversion<?,?> findConversion(Class<?> inType, Class<?> outType) {
4390      var toMeta = getClassMeta(outType);
4391      var fromMeta = getClassMeta(inType);
4392
4393      // --- ObjectSwap conversions (must come first) ---
4394      for (var swap : objectSwaps) {
4395         var nc = swap.getNormalClass().inner();
4396         var fc = swap.getSwapClass().inner();
4397         // Unswap: input is swap class (or convertible to it), output is normal class
4398         if (nc.isAssignableFrom(outType) && (fc.isAssignableFrom(inType) || Map.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) || Number.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))) {
4399            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4400               try {
4401                  var bs = marshallingSession(session);
4402                  var resolvedSwap = bs != null ? toMeta.getSwap(bs) : null;
4403                  var activeSwap = (ObjectSwap<Object,Object>) or(resolvedSwap, swap);
4404                  var swapClass = activeSwap.getSwapClass().inner();
4405                  // Direct match
4406                  if (swapClass.isInstance(in))
4407                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, in, toMeta);
4408                  // Intermediate Map conversion
4409                  if (Map.class.isAssignableFrom(swapClass) && in instanceof Map)
4410                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, converter.to(in, memberOf, bs, swapClass), toMeta);
4411                  // Intermediate Number conversion
4412                  if (Number.class.isAssignableFrom(swapClass) && in instanceof Number)
4413                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, converter.to(in, memberOf, bs, swapClass), toMeta);
4414                  // The swap's own swap-class is shaped like neither Map nor Number, so it doesn't apply to
4415                  // this input -- but if the input is already a Map matching toMeta's own Map shape, copy
4416                  // its entries directly rather than dropping the value.
4417                  return copyMapEntries(toMeta, in);
4418               } catch (Exception e) {
4419                  throw rex(e);
4420               }
4421            };
4422         }
4423         // Swap: input is normal class, output is swap class
4424         if (nc.isAssignableFrom(inType) && fc.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4425            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4426               try {
4427                  var bs = marshallingSession(session);
4428                  return ((ObjectSwap<Object,Object>) swap).swap(bs, in);
4429               } catch (Exception e) {
4430                  throw rex(e);
4431               }
4432            };
4433         }
4434      }
4435
4436      // --- Inline/auto-detected swaps from ClassMeta (e.g. AutoNumberSwap, AutoObjectSwap) ---
4437      // These are swaps found on the class itself (via swap() methods, toXxx() patterns, etc.)
4438      // and not registered in the objectSwaps list.
4439      var toSwap = toMeta.getSwap(null);
4440      if (toSwap != null) {
4441         // Use boxed version of swap class to handle primitive swap types (e.g. toInt() → int.class → Integer.class)
4442         var fcBoxed = info(toSwap.getSwapClass().inner()).getWrapperIfPrimitive().inner();
4443         if (fcBoxed.isAssignableFrom(inType) || Map.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) || Number.class.isAssignableFrom(inType)) {
4444            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4445               try {
4446               var bs = marshallingSession(session);
4447               var activeSwap = (ObjectSwap<Object,Object>) toMeta.getSwap(bs);
4448                  if (activeSwap == null) return null;
4449                  // Use boxed swap class to handle primitive return types (e.g. int.class → Integer.class)
4450                  var swapClass = info(activeSwap.getSwapClass().inner()).getWrapperIfPrimitive().inner();
4451                  if (swapClass.isInstance(in))
4452                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, in, toMeta);
4453                  if (Map.class.isAssignableFrom(swapClass) && in instanceof Map)
4454                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, converter.to(in, memberOf, bs, swapClass), toMeta);
4455                  if (Number.class.isAssignableFrom(swapClass) && in instanceof Number)
4456                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, converter.to(in, memberOf, bs, swapClass), toMeta);
4457                  // See the analogous fallback in the objectSwaps loop above.
4458                  return copyMapEntries(toMeta, in);
4459               } catch (Exception e) {
4460                  throw rex(e);
4461               }
4462            };
4463         }
4464      }
4465      var fromSwap = fromMeta.getSwap(null);
4466      if (fromSwap != null) {
4467         var fcBoxed = info(fromSwap.getSwapClass().inner()).getWrapperIfPrimitive().inner();
4468         if (fcBoxed.isAssignableFrom(outType) || outType == Object.class) {
4469            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4470               try {
4471               var bs = marshallingSession(session);
4472               var activeSwap = (ObjectSwap<Object,Object>) fromMeta.getSwap(bs);
4473                  if (activeSwap == null) return null;
4474                  return activeSwap.swap(bs, in);
4475               } catch (Exception e) {
4476                  throw rex(e);
4477               }
4478            };
4479         }
4480      }
4481
4482      // --- Date/time → CharSequence via Iso8601Utils (Gap 5) ---
4483      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(outType) && (fromMeta.isDateOrCalendarOrTemporal() || fromMeta.isDuration()))
4484         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> Iso8601Utils.format(in, fromMeta, sessionTimeZone(session));
4485
4486      // --- CharSequence → date/time via Iso8601Utils (Gap 6) ---
4487      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && (toMeta.isDateOrCalendarOrTemporal() || toMeta.isDuration()))
4488         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> Iso8601Utils.parse(in.toString(), toMeta, sessionTimeZone(session));
4489
4490      // --- Number → date/time via epoch millis (Gap 7) ---
4491      if (Number.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && toMeta.isDateOrCalendarOrTemporal())
4492         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> Iso8601Utils.fromEpochMillis(((Number)in).longValue(), toMeta, sessionTimeZone(session));
4493
4494      // --- Map/Bean/Collection/Array/Optional → String via serializer (Gap 14) ---
4495      if (outType == String.class) {
4496         // byte[] → String must come before isCollectionOrArrayOrOptional since byte[] is an array type
4497         if (byte[].class == inType)
4498            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> new String((byte[]) in, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
4499         if (fromMeta.isMapOrBean() || fromMeta.isCollectionOrArrayOrOptional()) {
4500            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4501               try {
4502                  var ws = getBeanToStringSerializer();
4503                  return ws != null ? ws.write(in) : in.toString();
4504               } catch (Exception e) {
4505                  throw rex(e);
4506               }
4507            };
4508         }
4509         if (Class.class == inType)
4510            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> ((Class<?>) in).getName();
4511      }
4512
4513      // --- CharSequence → Array via JSON parsing (Gap 10) ---
4514      // Excludes byte[] since that is handled by BasicConverter.findSpecialConversion (getBytes(UTF_8)).
4515      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && outType.isArray() && outType != byte[].class) {
4516         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4517            try {
4518               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4519               var str = in.toString();
4520               Json5List list;
4521               if (startsWith(str, '['))
4522                  list = Json5List.ofString(str).setBeanSession(bs);
4523               else
4524                  list = new Json5List((Object[]) splita(str)).setBeanSession(bs);
4525               return bs.convertToType(list, outType);
4526            } catch (Exception e) {
4527               throw rex(e);
4528            }
4529         };
4530      }
4531
4532      // --- CharSequence → Map via JSON parsing (Gap 11) ---
4533      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && Map.class.isAssignableFrom(outType) && !toMeta.canCreateNewInstanceFromString(null)) {
4534         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4535            try {
4536               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4537               var m = Json5Map.ofString(in.toString());
4538               m.setBeanSession(bs);
4539               return bs.convertToType(m, outType);
4540            } catch (Exception e) {
4541               throw rex(e);
4542            }
4543         };
4544      }
4545
4546      // --- Collection/Array → Collection with session-aware element conversion ---
4547      // When the target is an abstract collection type (List, Collection), uses JsonList instead of ArrayList
4548      // to preserve the session-aware default behavior from the original convertToCollectionType.
4549      if ((Collection.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) || inType.isArray()) && Collection.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4550         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4551            // Treat Object.class as "no element type" (untyped/raw, needs no element conversion).
4552            var elemType = args.length > 0 && args[0] != Object.class ? (Class<?>) args[0] : null;
4553            if (elemType == null && !inType.isArray() && outType.isAssignableFrom(in.getClass()))
4554               return in;
4555            var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4556            Collection<Object> result;
4557            if (outType.isAssignableFrom(JsonList.class)) {
4558               result = new JsonList(bs);  // Use JsonList for abstract types (List, Collection, Iterable)
4559            } else {
4560               result = newCollection(outType);
4561            }
4562            if (in instanceof Collection<?> col2) {
4563               for (var elem : col2)
4564                  result.add(elemType != null ? converter.to(elem, memberOf, session, elemType) : elem);
4565            } else {
4566               var len = Array.getLength(in);
4567               for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
4568                  var elem = Array.get(in, i);
4569                  result.add(elemType != null ? converter.to(elem, memberOf, session, elemType) : elem);
4570               }
4571            }
4572            return result;
4573         };
4574      }
4575
4576      // --- Map → Collection (wraps map as single element, preserving old convertToCollectionType behavior) ---
4577      if (Map.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && Collection.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4578         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4579            var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4580            Collection<Object> result;
4581            if (outType.isAssignableFrom(JsonList.class)) {
4582               result = new JsonList(bs);
4583            } else {
4584               result = newCollection(outType);
4585            }
4586            var elemType = args.length > 0 && args[0] != Object.class ? (Class<?>) args[0] : null;
4587            result.add(elemType != null ? converter.to(in, memberOf, session, elemType) : in);
4588            return result;
4589         };
4590      }
4591
4592      // --- CharSequence → Collection via JSON parsing (Gap 12) ---
4593      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && Collection.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4594         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4595            try {
4596               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4597               var str = in.toString();
4598               if (!isProbablyJsonArray(str, false))
4599                  throw rex("Cannot convert string to %s: %s", outType.getName(), str);
4600               var elemType = args.length > 0 ? args[0] : null;
4601               var l2 = Json5List.ofString(str).setBeanSession(bs);
4602               var result = newCollection(outType);
4603               l2.forEach(x -> result.add(elemType != null && x != null ? converter.to(x, elemType) : x));
4604               return result;
4605            } catch (Exception e) {
4606               throw rex(e);
4607            }
4608         };
4609      }
4610
4611      // --- Map → Bean via BeanMap/BuilderSwap/BeanRegistry (Gap 17) ---
4612      if (Map.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && toMeta.isBean()) {
4613         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4614            try {
4615               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4616               var m2 = (Map<?,?>) in;
4617               var builder = (BuilderSwap<Object,Object>) toMeta.getBuilderSwap(bs);
4618               if (m2 instanceof MarshalledMap mm && builder == null) {
4619                  var typeName = mm.getString(bs.getBeanTypePropertyName(toMeta));
4620                  if (nn(typeName)) {
4621                     var cm = toMeta.getBeanRegistry().getClassMeta(typeName);
4622                     if (nn(cm) && toMeta.isAssignableFrom(cm.inner()))

4624                  }
4625               }
4626               if (nn(builder)) {
4627                  var created = builder.create(bs, toMeta);
4628                  if (created != null) {
4629                     var bm = bs.toBeanMap(created);
4630                     bm.load(m2);
4631                     return builder.build(bs, checkRequired(bs, bm).getBean(), toMeta);
4632                  }
4633               }
4634               return checkRequired(bs, bs.newBeanMap(toMeta.inner()).load(m2)).getBean();
4635            } catch (Exception e) {
4636               var mrpe = MissingRequiredPropertyException.find(e);
4637               throw nn(mrpe) ? mrpe : rex(e);
4638            }
4639         };
4640      }
4641
4642      // --- CharSequence → URL (URL(String) is deprecated in Java 20+, use URI.create().toURL() instead) ---
4643      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && outType == URL.class)
4644         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4645            try {
4646               return new URI(in.toString()).toURL();
4647            } catch (Exception e) {
4648               throw rex(e);
4649            }
4650         };
4651
4652      // --- CharSequence → Bean via BeanMap (Gap 21) ---
4653      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && toMeta.isBean()) {
4654         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4655            try {
4656               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4657               return BeanMapLoader.load(bs.newBeanMap(toMeta.inner()), in.toString()).getBean();
4658            } catch (Exception e) {
4659               throw rex(e);
4660            }
4661         };
4662      }
4663
4664      // --- Calendar/Date specialized conversions (Gap 19) ---
4665      if (toMeta.isCalendar()) {
4666         if (Calendar.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4667            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4668               var c = (Calendar) in;
4669               var c2 = new GregorianCalendar(c.getTimeZone());
4670               c2.setTime(c.getTime());
4671               return c2;
4672            };
4673         if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4674            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4675               var c2 = new GregorianCalendar(TimeZone.getDefault());
4676               c2.setTime((Date) in);
4677               return c2;
4678            };
4679         if (Temporal.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4680            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4681               var temporal = (Temporal) in;
4682               Instant instant;
4683               try {
4684               instant = Instant.from(temporal);
4685               } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") DateTimeException e) {
4686               // LocalDateTime lacks offset info - interpret using session/system timezone
4687               var tz = sessionTimeZone(session);
4688               var zoneId = tz != null ? tz.toZoneId() : ZoneId.systemDefault();
4689               instant = LocalDateTime.from(temporal).atZone(zoneId).toInstant();
4690            }
4691            return Iso8601Utils.fromEpochMillis(instant.toEpochMilli(), toMeta, sessionTimeZone(session));
4692            };
4693      }
4694      if (toMeta.isDate() && outType == Date.class) {
4695         if (Calendar.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4696            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> ((Calendar) in).getTime();
4697         if (Temporal.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4698            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4699               var temporal = (Temporal) in;
4700               Instant instant;
4701               try {
4702               instant = Instant.from(temporal);
4703               } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") DateTimeException e) {
4704               // LocalDateTime lacks offset info - interpret using session/system timezone
4705               var tz = sessionTimeZone(session);
4706               var zoneId = tz != null ? tz.toZoneId() : ZoneId.systemDefault();
4707               instant = LocalDateTime.from(temporal).atZone(zoneId).toInstant();
4708            }
4709            return Date.from(instant);
4710            };
4711      }
4712
4713      // --- byte[]/CharSequence → InputStream (Gap 18) ---
4714      if (InputStream.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4715         if (byte[].class == inType)

4717         if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4718            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> { var b = in.toString().getBytes(); return new ByteArrayInputStream(b, 0, b.length); };
4719      }
4720
4721      // --- byte[]/CharSequence → Reader (Gap 18) ---
4722      if (Reader.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4723         if (byte[].class == inType)
4724            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> new StringReader(new String((byte[]) in));
4725         if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4726            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> new StringReader(in.toString());
4727      }
4728
4729      // --- CharSequence → Enum using ClassMeta (respects ignoreUnknownEnumValues) (Gap 13) ---
4730      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && outType.isEnum()) {
4731         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4732            try {
4733               return toMeta.newInstanceFromString(memberOf, in.toString());
4734            } catch (Exception e) {
4735               throw rex(e);
4736            }
4737         };
4738      }
4739
4740      // --- CharSequence → CharSequence subtype via ClassMeta (Gap 15) ---
4741      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && toMeta.isCharSequence() && outType != String.class && toMeta.canCreateNewInstanceFromString(null)) {
4742         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4743            try {
4744               return toMeta.newInstanceFromString(memberOf, in.toString());
4745            } catch (Exception e) {
4746               throw rex(e);
4747            }
4748         };
4749      }
4750
4751      // --- Array → CharSequence subtype via serializer (Gap 15) ---
4752      if (inType.isArray() && toMeta.isCharSequence() && outType != String.class && toMeta.canCreateNewInstanceFromString(null)) {
4753         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4754            try {
4755               var ws = getBeanToStringSerializer();
4756               var str = ws != null ? ws.write(in) : in.toString();
4757               return toMeta.newInstanceFromString(memberOf, str);
4758            } catch (Exception e) {
4759               throw rex(e);
4760            }
4761         };
4762      }
4763
4764      // --- Enum → T via toString() (allows Enum→Boolean, Enum→Number, etc.) ---
4765      // Excludes Enum→Enum (handled by BasicConverter) and Enum→String (handled by BasicConverter/CharSequence path).
4766      if (inType.isEnum() && !outType.isEnum() && !CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4767         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> converter.to(in.toString(), memberOf, session, outType, args);
4768      }
4769
4770      // --- Object → Boolean via toString() (lenient: any non-"true" string is false) ---
4771      // Excludes CharSequence types (handled by BasicConverter), primitives (handled by CachingConverter nullDefault),
4772      // and types that BasicConverter already handles (e.g. via toBoolean() instance method).
4773      if ((outType == Boolean.class || outType == boolean.class) && !CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && !Number.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && inType != boolean.class && inType != Boolean.class && !BasicConverter.INSTANCE.canConvert(inType, Boolean.class)) {
4774         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> converter.to(in.toString(), memberOf, session, Boolean.class);
4775      }
4776
4777   // --- Object → Bean via toString() + BeanMap.load() (fallback for bean-compatible types) ---
4778   // Replicates the old convertToMemberType fallback for beans (newBeanMap + load + getBean).
4779   // Excludes cases where input is already assignable to output (handled by MarshallingSession isInstance shortcut).
4780      if (toMeta.isBean() && !Map.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && !CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType)
4781            && !outType.isAssignableFrom(inType)) {
4782         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4783            try {
4784               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4785               return BeanMapLoader.load(bs.newBeanMap(toMeta.inner()), in.toString()).getBean();
4786            } catch (Exception e) {
4787               throw rex(e);
4788            }
4789         };

4807   private static Collection<Object> newCollection(Class<?> outType) {
4808      if (outType == List.class || outType == Collection.class || outType == Iterable.class || outType == AbstractList.class)
4809         return l();
4810      if (outType == Set.class || outType == LinkedHashSet.class || outType == AbstractSet.class)
4811         return new LinkedHashSet<>();
4812      if (outType == SortedSet.class || outType == NavigableSet.class || outType == TreeSet.class)
4813         return new TreeSet<>();
4814      try {
4815         return (Collection<Object>) outType.getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance();
4816      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") Exception e) {
4817         return l();
4818      }
4819   }

4872   /**
4873    * Used to resolve <c>ClassMetas</c> of type <c>Collection</c> and <c>Map</c> that have
4874    * <c>ClassMeta</c> values that themselves could be collections or maps.
4875    *
4876    * <p>
4877    * <c>Collection</c> meta objects are assumed to be followed by zero or one meta objects indicating the element type.
4878    *
4879    * <p>
4880    * <c>Map</c> meta objects are assumed to be followed by zero or two meta objects indicating the key and value types.
4881    *
4882    * <p>
4883    * The array can be arbitrarily long to indicate arbitrarily complex data structures.
4884    *
4885    * <h5 class='section'>Examples:</h5>
4886    * <ul>
4887    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(String.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A normal type.
4888    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(List.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A list containing objects.
4889    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(List.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A list containing strings.
4890    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A linked-list containing
4891    *       strings.
4892    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>, LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>);</code> -
4893    *       A linked-list containing linked-lists of strings.
4894    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(Map.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A map containing object keys/values.
4895    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(Map.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A map
4896    *       containing string keys/values.
4897    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(Map.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>, List.<jk>class</jk>, MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);</code> -
4898    *       A map containing string keys and values of lists containing beans.
4899    * </ul>
4900    *
4901    * @param <T>
4902    *    The class to resolve.
4903    * @param type
4904    *    The class to resolve.
4905    *    <br>Can be any of the following: {@link ClassMeta}, {@link ClassInfo}, {@link Class}, {@link ParameterizedType}, {@link GenericArrayType}
4906    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>null</jk>).
4907    * @param args
4908    *    The type arguments of the class if it's a collection or map.
4909    *    <br>Can be any of the following: {@link ClassMeta}, {@link ClassInfo}, {@link Class}, {@link ParameterizedType}, {@link GenericArrayType}
4910    *    <br>Ignored if the main type is not a map or collection.
4911    * @return The resolved class meta, or <jk>null</jk> if the type was <jk>null</jk>.
4912    */
4913   public final <T> ClassMeta<T> getClassMeta(Type type, Type...args) {
4914      if (type == null)
4915         return null;
4916      ClassMeta<T> cm = null;
4917      if (type instanceof Class type2)
4918         cm = getClassMeta(type2);
4919      else
4920         cm = resolveClassMeta(type, null);
4921      if (args.length == 0)
4922         return cm;
4923      var cma = new ClassMeta<?>[args.length + 1];
4924      cma[0] = cm;
4925      for (var i = 0; i < length(args); i++) {
4926         var arg = (Type)Array.get(args, i);
4927         if (arg instanceof Class arg2)
4928            cma[i + 1] = getClassMeta(arg2);
4929         else
4930            cma[i + 1] = resolveClassMeta(arg, null);
4931      }
4932      return (ClassMeta<T>)getTypedClassMeta(cma, 0);
4933   }

4935   /**
4936    * Returns the {@link ClassMeta} for the object's class, unwrapping recognized proxies first.
4937    *
4938    * <p>
4939    * Same contract as {@link MarshallingSession#getClassMetaForObject(Object, ClassMeta)}:
4940    * {@link org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.ClassUtils#getProxyFor(Object)} if non-<jk>null</jk>,
4941    * else {@code o.getClass()}. Used by object-tools and other context callers; parsers do not
4942    * call this method.
4943    *
4944    * @param <T> The class of the object being passed in.
4945    * @param o The object to find the class type for.
4946    *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
4947    * @return The ClassMeta object.
4948    */
4949   public final <T> ClassMeta<T> getClassMetaForObject(T o) {
4950      reqnn("o", o);
4951      var unwrapped = getProxyFor(o);
4952      Class<?> k = unwrapped != null ? unwrapped : o.getClass();
4953      return (ClassMeta<T>)getClassMeta(k);
4954   }

5545   /**
5546    * Used for determining the class type on a method or field where a {@code @BeanProp} annotation may be present.
5547    *
5548    * @param <T> The class type we're wrapping.
5549    * @param p The property annotation info on the type if there is one.
5550    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (the class type is resolved from <c>ci</c> alone, with no <ja>@BeanProp</ja>-based narrowing).
5551    * @param ci The class info for the type.
5552    * @param typeVarImpls
5553    *    Contains known resolved type parameters on the specified class so that we can result
5554    *    {@code ParameterizedTypes} and {@code TypeVariables}.
5555    *    Can be <jk>null</jk> if the information is not known.
5556    * @return The new {@code ClassMeta} object wrapped around the type.
5557    */
5558   protected final <T> ClassMeta<T> resolveClassMeta(AnnotationInfo<BeanProp> p, ClassInfo ci, TypeVariables typeVarImpls) {
5559      var cm = resolveClassMeta(ci, typeVarImpls);
5560      var cm2 = cm;
5561
5562      if (nn(p)) {
5563         var beanp = p.inner();
5564
5565         if (isNotVoid(beanp.type()))
5566            cm2 = resolveClassMeta(beanp.type(), typeVarImpls);
5567
5568         if (cm2.isMap()) {
5569            var pParams = (beanp.params().length == 0 ? a(Object.class, Object.class) : beanp.params());
5570            if (pParams.length != 2)
5571               throw rex("Invalid number of parameters specified for Map (must be 2): %s", pParams.length);
5572            var keyType = resolveType(pParams[0], cm2.getKeyType(), cm.getKeyType());
5573            var valueType = resolveType(pParams[1], cm2.getValueType(), cm.getValueType());
5574            if (keyType.isObject() && valueType.isObject())
5575               return cm2;
5576            return new ClassMeta<>(cm2, keyType, valueType, null);
5577         }
5578
5579         if (cm2.isCollection() || cm2.isOptional()) {
5580            var pParams = (beanp.params().length == 0 ? a(Object.class) : beanp.params());
5581            if (pParams.length != 1) {
5582               String typeName;
5583               if (cm2.isCollection()) {
5584                  typeName = "Collection";
5585               } else if (cm2.isOptional()) {
5586                  typeName = "Optional";
5587               } else {
5588                  typeName = "Array";
5589               }
5590               throw rex("Invalid number of parameters specified for %2$s (must be 1): %1$s", pParams.length, typeName);
5591            }
5592            var elementType = resolveType(pParams[0], cm2.getElementType(), cm.getElementType());
5593            if (elementType.isObject())
5594               return cm2;
5595            return new ClassMeta<>(cm2, null, null, elementType);
5596         }
5597
5598         // Handle @BeanProp(elementType=) for BeanSupplier, BeanConsumer, BeanChannel, and Stream properties.
5599         if (isNotVoid(beanp.elementType()) && (cm2.isIterable() || cm2.isStream())) {
5600            var elementType = resolveClassMeta(beanp.elementType(), typeVarImpls);
5601            if (! elementType.isObject())
5602               return new ClassMeta<>(cm2, null, null, elementType);
5603         }
5604
5605         return cm2;
5606      }
5607
5608      return cm;
5609   }

5627   /**
5628    * Finds the type parameters for a parameterized type.
5629    *
5630    * @param o The generic type.
5631    * @param c The raw class.
5632    * @return The array of {@link ClassMeta} for each type parameter, or an empty array if parameters cannot be resolved.
5633    */
5634   final ClassMeta[] findParameters(Type o, Class c) {
5635      if (o == null)
5636         o = c;
5637
5638      // Loop until we find a ParameterizedType
5639      if (! (o instanceof ParameterizedType)) {
5640         while (nn(c)) {
5641            o = c.getGenericSuperclass();
5642            if (!(o instanceof ParameterizedType))
5643               o = Arrays.stream(c.getGenericInterfaces()).filter(t -> t instanceof ParameterizedType).findFirst().orElse(null);
5644            if (o instanceof ParameterizedType)
5645               break;
5646            c = c.getSuperclass();
5647         }
5648      }
5649
5650      if (o instanceof ParameterizedType o2 && ! o2.getRawType().equals(Enum.class)) {
5651         var l = new LinkedList<ClassMeta<?>>();
5652         for (var pt2 : o2.getActualTypeArguments()) {
5653            if (pt2 instanceof WildcardType || pt2 instanceof TypeVariable)
5654               return new ClassMeta[0];
5655            l.add(resolveClassMeta(pt2, null));
5656         }
5657         if (l.isEmpty())
5658            return new ClassMeta[0];
5659         return l.toArray(new ClassMeta[l.size()]);
5660      }
5661
5662      return new ClassMeta[0];
5663   }
5664
5665   final ClassMeta resolveClassMeta(Type o, TypeVariables typeVars) {
5666      if (o == null)
5667         return null;
5668
5669      if (o instanceof ClassMeta<?> o2) {
5670
5671         // This classmeta could have been created by a different context.
5672         // Need to re-resolve it to pick up ObjectSwaps and stuff on this context.
5673         if (o2.getMarshallingContext() == this)
5674            return o2;
5675         if (o2.isMap())
5676            return getClassMeta(o2.inner(), o2.getKeyType(), o2.getValueType());
5677         if (o2.isCollection() || o2.isOptional())
5678            return getClassMeta(o2.inner(), o2.getElementType());
5679         return getClassMeta(o2.inner());
5680      }
5681
5682      // Handle ClassInfo by extracting the underlying Type
5683      if (o instanceof ClassInfo o2) {
5684         return resolveClassMeta(o2.innerType(), typeVars);
5685      }
5686
5687      var c = TypeVariables.resolve(o, typeVars);
5688
5689      // This can happen when trying to resolve the "E getFirst()" method on LinkedList, whose type is a TypeVariable
5690      // These should just resolve to Object.
5691      if (c == null)
5692         return object();
5693
5694      var rawType = getClassMeta(c);
5695
5696      // If this is a Map or Collection, and the parameter types aren't part
5697      // of the class definition itself (e.g. class AddressBook extends List<Person>),
5698      // then we need to figure out the parameters.
5699      if (rawType.isMap() || rawType.isCollection() || rawType.isOptional()) {
5700         var params = findParameters(o, c);
5701         if (params.length == 0)
5702            return rawType;
5703         if (rawType.isMap()) {
5704            if (params.length != 2 || (params[0].isObject() && params[1].isObject()))
5705               return rawType;
5706            return new ClassMeta(rawType, params[0], params[1], null);
5707         }
5708         if (rawType.isCollection() || rawType.isOptional()) {
5709            if (params.length != 1 || params[0].isObject())
5710               return rawType;
5711            return new ClassMeta(rawType, null, null, params[0]);
5712         }
5713      }
5714
5715      if (rawType.isArray() && o instanceof GenericArrayType o2) {
5716         var elementType = resolveClassMeta(o2.getGenericComponentType(), typeVars);
5717         return new ClassMeta(rawType, null, null, elementType);
5718      }
5719
5720      return rawType;
5721   }
5722
5723   /*
5724    * Resolves the 'genericized' class meta at the specified position in the ClassMeta array.
5725    */
5726   private ClassMeta<?> getTypedClassMeta(ClassMeta<?>[] c, int pos) {
5727      var cm = c[pos++];
5728      if (cm.isCollection() || cm.isOptional()) {
5729         var ce = c.length == pos ? object() : getTypedClassMeta(c, pos);
5730         return (ce.isObject() ? cm : new ClassMeta(cm, null, null, ce));
5731      } else if (cm.isMap()) {
5732         var ck = c.length == pos ? object() : c[pos++];
5733         var cv = c.length == pos ? object() : getTypedClassMeta(c, pos);
5734         return (ck.isObject() && cv.isObject() ? cm : new ClassMeta(cm, ck, cv, null));
5735      }
5736      return cm;
5737   }
5738
5739
5740   private ClassMeta<?> resolveType(Type...t) {
5741      for (var tt : t) {
5742         if (nn(tt)) {
5743            var cm = getClassMeta(tt);
5744            if (tt != cmObject)
5745               return cm;
5746         }
5747      }
5748      return cmObject;
5749   }
